Name: Cicada Companion
Author: SuperMattyM8
Description:
[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]

This is a fairly simple mod that replaces the fairy companion, and associated trinket, the fairy box, with cicadas.
Includes 8 variations of the cicadas, some based off real world cicadas and some made up.

Comes with a config, you can select one of the 8 variants you'd like for your companion, or set it to "default" to use whatever variant the game has predetermined for the player.

Should be compatible with any other mods that change any other companion, as this mod ONLY edits the fairy companion's textures.

[size=4][b]How to install:

[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3] Extract file into your mod folder.[/size]
[*][size=3] And done! Use the config to select your preferred companion, otherwise, leave on default.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]
